children: Britain is choosing “Brussels over America,” causing a “problem” for London’s effort to expand its trade deal with Washington, U.S. Trade Representative Jamieson Greer told the Financial Times in an interview published on Friday.
Greer told the paper that Britain had failed to take advantage of Brexit by aligning with the European Union's rules while closing its market to American goods and it still had “pretty high tariffs."
